_comment_template: Template — copy to .claude/settings.json in the consumer repo. Pairs with hooks/lint-on-edit.sh and the `lint:` recipe in the Makefile (see ../SKILL.md). Adjust the command path if you store the hook elsewhere.
_comment_coverage_gap: PostToolUse Edit|Write does NOT cover files written via the Bash tool (e.g. `echo > file.ts`). For full coverage, complement with a pre-commit git hook running `make lint` over `git diff --name-only`.
